# Glass Gallery (MODVC)
> Curated high-resolution visual repository, deep-space astrophotography, anime art, and community photo sharing.

## Overview
Glass Gallery (https://gg.modvc.org) is an open, high-performance web platform for discovering, sharing, and archiving high-resolution digital art, telescope astrophotography from James Webb (JWST) and Hubble (HST), anime digital creations, and 4K desktop wallpapers.

## Key URL Directory
- Homepage: https://gg.modvc.org/
- Complete Gallery Directory: https://gg.modvc.org/gallery
- Developer REST API: https://gg.modvc.org/api
- Terms of Service: https://gg.modvc.org/legal?tab=terms
- Privacy Policy: https://gg.modvc.org/legal?tab=privacy
- Community Guidelines: https://gg.modvc.org/legal?tab=guidelines
- Contact & Inquiries: contact@modvc.org

## Media Licensing & Attribution
Images on Glass Gallery support open Creative Commons (CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA) and public observatory releases. Original source links and artist credits are attached to posts where available.
